prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, side view, flat cel-shaded vanilla-RimWorld toy-figurine art style: the Star Wars canon Anooba — a lean, hyena-like predator native to Tatooine-like deserts, domesticated by Jawas as a hunting and guard beast.
